title: Close connectedness of the moduli stack of reduced curves
summary: We prove that the moduli stack of all reduced $n$-pointed curves is ``closely connected'' in characteristic zero, in the sense that each irreducible component of the stack intersects the component of smoothable curves. We achieve this by performing a detailed study of Ishii's territories, moduli schemes parametrizing reduced curve singularities together with a normalization map. We give explicit equations for territories, bound their dimensions, describe certain functoriality properties, and study the action of several groups on territories.
